positions.text: From Product Search to Preference Articulation: The Economics of Agentic Commerce independently states that generative AI is moving digital commerce toward agentic search in which consumers delegate product discovery to AI agents. This supports the proximate-agency shift identified in Kaal's source-bound economics claim. The abstract does not establish that humans cease to be the proximate driver throughout the agentic layer or that traditional demand-side economics loses descriptive accuracy, so the relationship is a narrow qualification rather than full validation.
